fresh_attempt: One persistent O_CREAT|O_EXCL root lock and fresh owned_supervisor/run01 plus fabricated_cpu/run01. Lock remains spent after success, failure or interruption. No retry.
known_limits: RSS is independently sampled aggregate owned-session RSS, not an OS-enforced instantaneous ceiling. Root review must assess whether this monitoring semantics satisfies its requested physical gate.
SIGALRM terminates the held original child group at the 900-second deadline. Reaping/observation bookkeeping has at most5seconds cleanup after stop; an over-limit child can never PASS.

An unexpected new group/session is an ownership exception. The wrapper kills only the held original child group or direct child, records unresolved ownership and cannot claim physical closure for escaped processes. It does not implement an OS process-escape sandbox.
A supervisor SIGKILL, host power loss or unavailable storage can prevent its terminal/final write; durable STARTED/root lock retain incurrence, and missing final evidence cannot qualify.
